# uptimeeye_monitor (Resource)

A monitor runs one or more test steps from the configured locations and alerts the associated notification channel on failure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeeye_monitor" "api" {
  name                    = "API Healthcheck"
  notification_channel_id = uptimeeye_notification_channel.oncall.id
  locations               = ["eu-central-1"]

  steps = [{
    name = "GET /health"
    type = "http"
    request = {
      url    = "https://api.example.com/health"
      method = "GET"
    }
    asserts = [{
      type     = "body"
      property = "statusCode"
      operator = "is"
      expected = "200"
    }]
  }]

  options = {
    tick_every = 60
    timeout    = 5000
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locations` (List of String) Locations the monitor runs from.
- `name` (String) Display name of the monitor.
- `notification_channel_id` (String) ID of the notification channel that receives alerts for this monitor.
- `options` (Attributes) Scheduling and alerting options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))
- `steps` (Attributes List) Test steps executed in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is paused. Paused monitors do not run checks.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for organizing monitors.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Monitor identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Required:

- `tick_every` (Number) Check frequency in seconds.
- `timeout` (Number) How long to wait for a response in seconds.

Optional:

- `failure_threshold` (Number) Number of consecutive failures before triggering an alarm.
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Whether to follow HTTP redirects.
- `location_threshold` (Number) Number of locations that must fail before triggering an alarm.


<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `request` (Attributes) Request executed by this step. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--request))
- `type` (String) Step type.

Optional:

- `asserts` (Attributes List) Assertions evaluated against the step response. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--asserts))
- `extracted_values` (Attributes List) Values extracted from the step response for use in subsequent steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--extracted_values))
- `name` (String) Display name of the step.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--request"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.request`

Required:

- `url` (String) Target URL (or host for dns/icmp steps).

Optional:

- `body` (String) Request body.
- `header` (Attributes List) Request headers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--request--header))
- `method` (String) HTTP method.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--request--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.request.header`

Required:

- `key` (String) Header name.
- `value` (String) Header value.



<a id="nestedatt--steps--asserts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.asserts`

Required:

- `expected` (String) Expected value.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator.
- `type` (String) What part of the response to assert on.

Optional:

- `property` (String) Property the assertion refers to (e.g. header name or JSON path), depending on type.


<a id="nestedatt--steps--extracted_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.extracted_values`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name under which the extracted value is available.
- `type` (String) Where the value is extracted from.

Optional:

- `location` (String) Header name or JSON path depending on type. Not used with http_body_raw.
